title: Secondary Sorting with ThenBy & ThenByDescending
description: Learn to apply secondary sorting using ThenBy and ThenByDescending in method syntax.

data.text: The `ThenBy` and `ThenByDescending` extension methods are used for sorting on multiple fields in method syntax.
The `OrderBy()` method sorts the collection in ascending order based on a specified field. Use `ThenBy()` after `OrderBy` to sort the collection on another field in ascending order.
LINQ first sorts the collection based on the primary field (specified by `OrderBy`) and then sorts the result again based on the secondary field (specified by `ThenBy`).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: ThenBy applies secondary sorting in ascending order
ThenByDescending applies secondary sorting in descending order
Must be used after OrderBy or OrderByDescending
Multiple ThenBy calls can be chained for complex sorting
